retained_development_failure.cause: New test argument dtype collided with global parametrization; renamed to payload_dtype in immutable dev02, whose CPU13/NPU8 gate passed.

limits: Consumer-only optional timing. Core/resident/CANN components are byte-verified unchanged dependencies; no backend rebuild or fresh profile claim.

Default off adds no middle synchronization. Enabled training synchronizes all resolved devices once before final finite checks, update and publication; the extra synchronization is included in complete elapsed time.

CPU13/NPU8 directed tests include 40 actual default/enabled CLI candidates, FP32/FP64 CPU and FP32/FP16 NPU, one/two-card resident paths, physical sample chunks, warmup and measured continuation. Independent CPU verifies complete observables and updates; no reference events or gradients feed a candidate.
Diagnostic timings include observable export and are not throughput measurements or a cost extrapolation. Larger-batch training and performance remain separate gates.
